question: Where is the Lokrang Utsav celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Madhya Pradesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The city of Lakes Bhopal in Madhya Pradesh organises the __cultural festival 'Lokrang' on its land.
 
• Its an extravagant event organized each year by the Directorate of Culture and Madhya Pradesh Tribal Museum
 
• The five-day cultural extravaganza emboldens rich tribal and folk traditions of India through various cultural performances
 __
 
• such as performing arts classical dance tribal folk dance and exhibitions of art and crafts Bracing rural culture since 20 years
 
• Lokrang Festival is celebrated and inaugurated on Republic Day 26th January every year followed by closing on 30th January.
 
 
 
• This festival attracts tourists dance connoisseurs music connoisseurs and artists from all over the globe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other Festivals of Madhya Pradesh 
 
• Khajuraho Dance Festival
 
 
• The Khajuraho Dance Festival, organized by the Madhya Pradesh Kala Parishad, is a one-week festival of classical dances
 
• It held annually beside the Khajuraho temples in the Chhatarpur district of Madhya Pradesh state in central India.
 
• The festival is conducted in February from the 20th to the 26th.
 
 
 
• Madhya Pradesh Jal Mahotsav
 
 
• Jal Mahotsav is organized every year from November to January and the Tent City is operational with all the activities.
 
• It is a great pleasure to update you regarding the experience called Jal Mahotsav (Hanuwantiya, Khandwa).
 
• Located on the banks of the Indira Sagar dam in Madhya Pradesh, Hanuwantiya is a glorious spectacle of nature.
